overview: File concerns Japanese zinc-smelter sulfur-fume controls, including a 1934 Tokyo instruction and a phone memo on possible Department help to an unnamed company.

people.name: Mackay
people.role: State Department representative who relayed the substance of a Tokyo Embassy telegram

people.name: Dundas
people.role: Representative associated with the unnamed company requesting assistance

subfiles.title: Note on control of sulfur fumes from Japanese zinc smelters
subfiles.about: A filing note records a request for information about Japanese practices for controlling sulfur fumes discharged from zinc-smelter stacks.
subfiles.summary: Note seeks information on Japan's sulfur-fume controls at zinc smelters, per a 1933 Tokyo instruction.

subfiles.title: Memorandum of telephone conversation between Mackay and Dundas
subfiles.about: The memorandum records a telephone conversation concerning a request for Department assistance mentioned in a Tokyo Embassy telegram.
subfiles.summary: Mackay tells Dundas State is considering a company's request tied to Japan's zinc-smelting pollution issue.

interest: Shows a 1934 commercial inquiry on Japanese zinc-smelter pollution controls, handled via embassy and phone coordination.
